protocol.scope: Select the smallest affected area and direct dependencies; exclude generated, dependency, cache, and unrelated source.
protocol.initialize: When a target artifact or its parent folder is missing, create it from the matching _template artifact before editing. For a new work item, initialize every file from devspec/work-items/_template, including meta.md. Never overwrite an existing artifact.
protocol.evidence: Label durable facts as confirmed, observed, inferred, or blocked.
protocol.change: Prefer existing patterns and the smallest safe change; do not add speculative abstractions or dependencies.
protocol.artifacts: Update targeted sections only, link instead of duplicate, and preserve user-authored useful content.
